title: What the Evidence Constellation Engine is
description: The engine maintains constellations: each conclusion surrounded by its supporting sources, its counterevidence, the conclusions it depends on, and its uncertainty assessment. Nothing stands alone. When evidence changes, the constellation updates and every dependent conclusion is re-evaluated automatically.

title: Constellation data model
description: A constellation is a record: the conclusion statement, supporting sources with weights, counterevidence with weights, dependency links to other conclusions, uncertainty decomposition, and a verdict with its margin. The model makes 'what would change my mind' a computable question — the nearest strong counterevidence.

title: Evidence weighing algorithm
description: Not all evidence weighs the same: replicated experiments outweigh single observations, independent sources outweigh correlated ones, direct measurements outweigh proxies. The weighing algorithm combines source reliability, independence, and relevance into weights, and publishes the weighting so it can be argued with.

title: Dependency propagation algorithm
description: Conclusions depend on conclusions: if a supporting study is retracted, every conclusion downstream must be re-evaluated. The propagator walks the dependency graph on evidence changes, recomputes verdicts in topological order, and reports exactly which conclusions changed and why.

title: Reasoning: verdicts with margins
description: A verdict is not just 'supported' — it is 'supported with margin 2.3, nearest counterevidence at weight 1.1'. Margins make verdicts actionable: thin margins trigger watchfulness, wide margins allow reliance. When margins cross thresholds, the engine raises or lowers its confidence publicly.

title: Failure modes: evidence laundering and cascade errors
description: Evidence can be laundered — one source cited many times looking like many sources — and errors cascade through dependencies. The engine fights laundering with independence analysis and cascades with propagation that shows its work. Every verdict can answer 'which three sources matter most' to expose laundering.

title: Scaling: constellations at web scale
description: Millions of conclusions need partitioned constellations: sharded by topic with cross-shard dependency links, propagation bounded by impact radius, and lazy recomputation for low-stakes conclusions. The engine scales by not recomputing the world on every new paper — only the affected neighborhood.

title: Security: evidence integrity
description: Constellations are only as honest as their evidence links: signed sources, tamper-evident citation records, and provenance verification before admission. Fabricated evidence is treated as an attack — quarantined, investigated, and its submitter flagged across the system.
